name: Sono Hanabira ni Kuchizuke o: Watashi no Ouji-sama
original_name: その花びらにくちづけを わたしの王子さま
source:
I am Kitajima Kaede, and I am not really good at dealing with people. I'm also the class rep.
In school, I run into my cousin Sara, and suddenly I find myself sharing a passionate kiss with her!
In the years that I haven't seen her, she's grown into a cute, outgoing girl who has become a famous model.
Even fashion magazines know about her, and many in my school idolize her. She makes me look extra dull by comparison.

And yet she calls me out from afar and clings to me, heedless of the stares people give us.
Because I don't like to stand out, I instinctively act coldly towards Sara.
But then she suddenly pushed me down. She whispers to me,
"I want everything there is you."
Such joy, such bliss and such embarrassment. What's to become of me?

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE031762.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
我叫北岛枫，不太擅长与人打交道。我也是班长。
在学校里，我遇到了表妹纱良，突然间就和她接了一个热吻！
多年不见，她已经长成了一个可爱、开朗的女孩，还成了一名知名模特。
时尚杂志上都有她的身影，学校里也有许多人崇拜她。相比之下，我显得格外黯淡。

然而她却在远处呼唤我的名字，不顾旁人的目光紧贴着我。
因为我不喜欢引人注目，所以本能地对纱良表现得很冷淡。
但她突然把我推倒了。她在我耳边低语：
"我想要你的一切。"
如此快乐、如此幸福、如此害羞。我会变成什么样呢？

[来自[url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE031762.html]DLsite[/url]]
